subject: Mutual Action Plan: weekly checkpoint — RSVP, agenda & timing

Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Mutual Action Plan: weekly checkpoint — proposed recurring hold

Hi Sara —

Thanks again for the time on Friday. To keep momentum on the MAP and the evaluation plan, I wanted to propose a short weekly checkpoint (30 minutes) for the next 6 weeks so we can:

- Review progress on the MAP milestones (technical eval, procurement, security checklist)
- Walk through any blockages and owners
- Validate early evaluation results and tweak prompts/throughput settings

Proposed cadence: weekly 30-min meeting (we'll keep it tight). Suggested windows next week:
- Tue 10:00–10:30 ET / 15:00–15:30 BST
- Wed 14:00–14:30 ET / 19:00–19:30 BST (if later works for your team)

Attendees: Naomi Feldman (Redwood AE), Camila Reyes (Solutions Engineer), Sara Thompson (Quantic Health PO), procurement@quantichealth.com (procurement lead)

Draft agenda attached: meeting_agenda_qh.xlsx
I've also attached the latest MAP (mutual-action-plan_v3.xlsx) and the evaluation plan (evaluation_plan_v2.docx) so your team can eyeball before the first checkpoint. Please let me know which time works or propose a different slot — happy to accommodate timezones.

If it helps, I can include a short section for procurement to list 'must-have' clauses ahead of any legal/contract review.

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com | (415) 555-0198
